ANIFACZIT，A hyper-realistic digital artwork of an anime-style young woman with short, light blue hair and delicate facial features, kneeling gracefully on a weathered stone sea wall at twilight. She wears a pale pink tank top paired with dark leather shorts adorned with silver studs, complemented by black thigh-high boots; her look is enhanced by a thin headband and choker necklace.

The scene unfolds against the backdrop of a serene coastal cityscape under a luminous full moon casting soft glow over calm ocean waters reflecting distant lights — including illuminated buildings along the shore and a glowing lighthouse in the distance. The atmosphere evokes quiet contemplation as she gazes thoughtfully toward the horizon while waves gently lap beneath her feet.

Rendered with cinematic lighting that blends natural dusk tones with artificial urban illumination, creating depth through shallow focus blur effects (bokeh) for background elements like skyline lights, enhancing foreground clarity. Style: photorealistic 3D render or high-fidelity AI-generated imagery resembling Unreal Engine visuals—ideal for wallpapers or concept art showcasing ethereal beauty juxtaposed with gritty seaside realism.
